events.event: GoTo releases a free 27-billion-parameter AI language model (built on Google's Gemma 3) on Hugging Face that supports Indonesian, Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese and Batak Toba.
events.key_numbers: 27 billion parameters · 6 languages · 128,000-token context · needs ~54-60 GB GPU memory (Nvidia A100 80 GB recommended) · Gemma license, not fully open source
events.why_it_matters: A big Indonesian tech firm gives away an AI that understands regional languages, but it is built on a foreign base model and can hallucinate.
events.spreading_evidence: top of detik inet front page

events.event: Komdigi Deputy Minister Nezar Patria says the ministry is studying a ministerial regulation that would require labels on AI-generated content to curb fraud.
events.key_numbers: Still under study, no timeline or penalties · National AI Roadmap 2026-2029 involves 400+ institutions · example: Hong Kong deepfake meeting fraud US$25 M, 15 transfers
events.why_it_matters: If adopted, AI videos and images on Indonesian social media could carry mandatory labels, which matters for deepfake scams.

events.event: Komdigi (Deputy Minister Angga Raka Prabowo) says it is studying telecom deregulation to cut regulatory costs that take 13-14% of mobile operators' revenue, with 2029 targets for broadband speed and 5G coverage.
events.key_numbers: Regulatory cost 13-14% of operator revenue · industry growth room 5% · 2029 targets: up to 100 Mbps, 50% of households on home internet (wording garbled), 90% of kecamatan on fiber, 5G coverage 51% · 4G covers 98%+ of territory · no BHP/USO figures or legal instrument yet
events.why_it_matters: Lower operator costs could mean cheaper or better data plans, but the government has promised this before and nothing is decided.

events.event: At the Bali Tech Week opening, Minister Bahlil Lahadalia says the government will issue a 'win-win' data-centre investment regulation under which foreign investors should partner with national and regional businesses; Komdigi's Meutya Hafid says AI factory and data-centre development must be coordinated with energy supply.
events.key_numbers: No investment, capacity or job figures given · no legal form or timeline · data centres use large electricity and water, limited jobs

sources.label: Katadata (BP Batam water rule, DPR review)

events.why_it_matters: Sets the conditions for the data-centre boom (Nvidia Batam talks, Danantara plans) and who gets a share of it.

events.event: Indonesian iPhone Duo price and date remain unofficial: a Jakarta billboard says sales on 30 Oct and a leaked BRI document lists Rp43.99 M for 256 GB, while Bisnis says Indonesian delivery may only come next year; global pre-orders opened 16 Oct at US$1,999.
events.key_numbers: Leaked BRI prices: 256 GB Rp43,999,000 · 512 GB Rp47,999,000 · 1 TB Rp55,999,000 · 2 TB Rp68,999,000 · US$1,999 (256 GB) to US$3,199 (2 TB) · global availability 23 Oct · IDC ~7 M units in 2026 · Counterpoint <=6 M units initially · some delivery estimates late Jan 2027 · Katadata's 'Rp36 M' is just US$ conversion
events.why_it_matters: A foldable iPhone priced above Rp40 juta is the most expensive iPhone ever sold in Indonesia, and the sources disagree on when it arrives.
events.spreading_evidence: iPhone Duo stories across detik, Katadata, Bisnis and CNBC Indonesia (19-20 Oct)

events.event: Apple will hold an event on 28 October where a touchscreen MacBook Pro is widely expected.
events.key_numbers: Event 28 Oct 2026 · details taken from detik and CNBC Indonesia headlines only, article not opened
events.why_it_matters: Another big Apple price point for Indonesian buyers just after the iPhone launches.

events.event: DPR Komisi VII asks the government to evaluate the 8% ojol commission cap, citing driver complaints and a UGM survey that found lower commissions do not automatically raise drivers' net income; Komisi V warns that splitting oversight across three ministries risks delays.
events.key_numbers: Commission cut 20% to 8% (passenger services, from July) · drivers keep at least 92% · Prabowo said on 14 Aug that driver income rose 2-3x · UGM survey Sep-2 Oct 2026, five cities · implementing rules due by 31 Dec 2026 · Perpres 27/2026 announced 8 Oct · 3 ministries: Kemenhub, Komdigi, Kementerian UMKM
events.why_it_matters: Millions of ojol drivers and riders: a lower app commission does not guarantee higher take-home pay.

events.event: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto sets a Harbolnas 2026 transaction target of Rp40 trillion, now counting online travel agents, ojol and social commerce as well as e-commerce.
events.key_numbers: Target Rp40 T (~+10%) · 2025 realisation Rp36.4 T (target Rp35 T; +17% from Rp31.2 T in 2024) · local products Rp16.6 T (45.6%) in 2025 · Harbolnas dates 10-16 Dec (year not stated in article) · e-commerce market projected to grow 14%+ to US$71 B
events.why_it_matters: Harbolnas is the biggest online shopping season; the wider counting makes the target easier to hit.

events.event: Security reports warn of Hirudo, an Android banking-trojan/remote-access malware that targets banking apps and spreads through fake shopping or entertainment apps, ads and fake download pages.
events.key_numbers: No infection counts or losses reported · steals logins and SMS, uses Android accessibility features to control the phone · attributed to ThreatFabric (per Bisnis)
events.why_it_matters: A scam wave that can empty bank accounts from a phone, with simple steps people can take to protect themselves.
